tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 10.0 is the current latest LTS, providing long-term support beyond .NET 8.0 (which reaches end of support in November 2026), improved performance, and access to modern runtime and language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution from net8.0 to net10.0. This includes updating the TargetFramework in Directory.Packages.props, updating the SDK version in global.json, updating all NuGet package references (ASP.NET Core 10.x, Entity Framework Core 10.x, Azure SDK, and third-party packages) to .NET 10.0-compatible versions, and resolving any breaking API changes introduced between .NET 8.0 and .NET 10.0. All ten projects must be updated: Web, PublicApi, Infrastructure, ApplicationCore, BlazorShared, BlazorAdmin, IntegrationTests, UnitTests, FunctionalTests, and PublicApiIntegrationTests.
